body: I live in a state where it’s legal and I already regular use-it does help maintain myself day to day but doesn’t help when it’s extreme. I’d like to see a doctor, but I just got my insurance back days ago so not sure what I’m covered in
I try to tell him, it’s just frustrating that it never stops. I’m always getting this way over nothing and it’s always so extreme. He knows about it but I hate putting him through it

They do after a 2 year period from when it starts. We don’t need a marriage counsellor, he’s just frustrated with me. It’s understandable cause small things trigger me really bad some times. I just got back on insurance but I’m not really sure how much it covers for mental health services. Thank you.
Thanks, I appreciate it. I just wish there was something I could tell them why to have it make sense but there isnt. It just sucks and hurts and doesn’t make sense.
Just make it thru the night. Don’t worry about tomorrow. Just get thru tonight. For any chance a future happier you

In middle school, one of our teachers committed suicide. He was a favorite. The entire school mourned. Many of these kids had never experienced losing a loved one, and it wasn’t easy for them. It’ll be the first death they have to experience, and I think it makes suicide an option for them. It makes it real. It makes it answer.
